flags.summary: In August 2022 the Herald Republican reported that Lies 'unsuccessfully sued the district last year in a dispute over the school's COVID-19 policies,' and that the suit was dismissed in the district's favor in Steuben Circuit Court in early January 2022. This guide found no response from Lies.
flags.note: A civil lawsuit against the district he now helps govern. Only this newspaper account was read; the court record, the claims and how the case was dismissed were not checked.
